comment: The EXT input and the CLK output have no family because the menu switches what they carry between clock pulses and a tempo voltage. Those two menu items appear in two places: on the module's own menu at Clocker2.cpp:1847 and :1866, and on each jack's own right-click menu through appendClockInMenu at :56 and appendClockOutMenu at :66. The div/mult knob is a snapped parameter over 0 to 44 with a custom quantity printing /256 up to x256, x1 at the centre. The BPM parameter is configured over 300 to 3000 with a display multiplier of 0.1, which is why it reads 30.0 to 300.0 BPM.
